en: Leave the gun. Rest doesn't matter.

ru: Кэп, ты меня лапаешь или командуешь?
en: Cap, are you poking or commanding?
Take everything. Even the ugly stuff.
Listening. Make it quick, I'm busy.
Cap, I want a bigger cut.

ru: Чего надо? Грабёж — это ко мне.

en: Talk, Cap. My hands are itching.

ru: Кто звал лучшую девку на борту?
en: Who called the best gal aboard?
Yeah. I can smell the loot.
Off I go. Get in my way, regret it.
Got it. Looking for loose stuff.
Your money or your life? Both.

ru: Кэп, я с первого раза поняла.
en: Cap, I got it the first time.
Poke me again and I bite.
Need the best? Here she is.
Good plan. Stay out of it.
In short bounds. Like I was taught.
One shot. That's all it takes.

ru: Ты не первый. И не последний.
en: Not the first. Not the last.

ru: Я и в первый раз поняла.
en: I got it the first time.
Once more and you go yourself.
Been here long. Used to it.
Need sleep. About three years' worth.
I'll get there. Not my first.
Wherever you say, I'll get there.
Back wants a lift. No lift.
I'll get there even if I shouldn't.

ru: Не смотри на ноги. Они стесняются.
en: Don't look at my legs. They're shy.
Can I have the big grenade?
Cap, I've almost got an idea!

ru: Ой, кэп. А я тут думала...
en: Oh, Cap. I was just thinking...
Hi! Are we blowing stuff up?

ru: Кэп, а у тебя глаза смешные.
Туда? А почему не вон туда?

en: Can I touch him? With a bullet?
You'll love it. I sure will.
What about the head? Let's see!
Poke-poke. I can do that too.
Quiet. I'm listening to the floor.

ru: Что ты хочешь? Я хочу всё.
en: What do you want? I want everything.
I'm here. I think I'm everywhere.
One sec. Finishing a chat with a bullet.
I sneezed and something blew up.

ru: Мне сказали не трогать. Я тронула.
en: Told not to touch. I touched.
The voices in my head are nice today.
Cap, you're in my dreams. Often.

ru: У меня три руки. Шучу. Две.
en: I have three hands. Kidding. Two.

ru: Я бы помогла. Но забыла как.
Я пойду, а ты не смотри.

en: Just for a minute. Over there.
Did I fall? No, lying down.
My feet argue where to go.
My legs are smarter than my head.
I walk on the ceiling. Sometimes.

ru: Иду. Если пропаду, я в стене.
en: Going. If I vanish, I'm in a wall.
Cap, the axe wants a walk.

ru: Не стой там. Там потом взорвётся.
en: Don't stand there. It'll explode later.
I'll talk to him. From inside.
I'm feeling kind. Make it count.

ru: Да. Я знаю, что ты скажешь.
en: Yes. I know what you'll say.
Smells like rain and blood today.
There. The dead keep it warm.
Following my own tracks. In advance.
Moving. My shadow will catch up.

ru: Иду. На тень мою не наступай.
en: Going. Don't step on my shadow.
Don't be scared. It's quick. Probably.
Say bye. Go on, say it.
I hear you. So do they.

ru: Ещё раз — и я отвечу. Странно.
en: Once more and I answer. Weirdly.

ru: Шш. Я разговариваю. Не с тобой.
en: Shh. I'm talking. Not to you.
The door's looking at us again.
Don't make noise. The clocks sleep.
The crows owe me. A lot.
I died yesterday. It was boring.
There's a cloud in my pocket.

ru: Ты похож на моего покойного соседа.
en: You look like my late neighbor.
I'm not strange. Everyone else is.
I ate a slipper. It was alive.
Listening. Someone on my left agrees.
I'll walk the edge of silence.
I'll open doors myself. Don't watch.
Going. The path will curl up.
Going, or I'll be late yesterday.
I'll pass through the empty place.
Going together. There's more of us.

ru: Если не вернусь, я просто вышла.
en: If I don't return, I stepped out.

ru: Бегу? Нет. Я просто быстро стою.

en: Going. Say hi to the mice.

ru: Пошла бы. Но я уже там.
en: I'd go. But I'm already there.
We'll pray for that one too.
Heard you, Cap. Don't tempt me.
I'll sort out my conscience later.
Going. A sinner's road is long.
Going. I'll light a candle later.
Forgive me. I'm about to hit you.

ru: Ох, как хорошо... То есть плохо.
en: Oh, that feels good... I mean bad.

ru: Ещё раз — и это грех. Твой.
en: Once more is a sin. Yours.
I'll pray for you too. Loudly.

ru: Господи, дай мне сил. На него.
en: Lord, give me strength. For him.
Lord, have mercy. What is it?
Don't disturb my penance. But speak.
Give me a reason to sin.
Prayer is short. The task is longer.
My confession is longer than yours.
I was absolved of everything. In advance.
Sainthood can wait. The fight can't.
The cross is heavy, but I go.
The path is thorny. I like it.
I'll pray off sins on the way.
Hard to sin standing still. Going.
I won't slip. Sins aplenty already.
May the way be clear. For now.

ru: Бог видит. Но ему не жалко.

en: Going to repent. Brawl on the way.
If I fall, it's a bow.

ru: Ну, прости мне и эту тропинку.
en: Forgive me this little path too.

ru: Правая за веру, левая за грех.
en: Right foot for faith, left for sin.
I'm going. Hands off the candles.
Coming. I'd like to live, though.
I'm here. Where would I go?
Working. Not for free, I hope.

ru: Цепи сняли, и на том спасибо.
Вот бы так до пенсии дойти...
en: If only this led to retirement...
Poke me again and I quit.
Do I get extra for this?
That's it, I'm filing a complaint.

ru: Я готов. Не сильно, но готов.

en: Make it quick. Feet are cold.
I know your quick and easy.
You say it, I do it. Grumbling.
Could at least let me sleep.
I'm used to it. To anything.
My back hurts. Theirs will too.

ru: Мне б дом, жену и тишину.
en: A house, a wife and silence.
I'm a simple man. I hit hard.

ru: Лопату бы мне. Была бы жизнь.
en: Give me a shovel. That's a life.

ru: Налей мне горячего. И я твой.
en: Pour me something hot. I'm yours.

ru: Я бы спел. Но связки сели.

en: I'll get there. If not shot.
Got it. Heading to death. Kidding.

ru: Как скажешь. Мои ноги, твоя воля.
en: As you say. My legs, your will.

ru: Если не вернусь, я в отпуске.
en: If I'm not back, I'm on leave.
I only run from the taxman.
I'd take a horse. Any one.
Running like to a meeting. Slowly.
Relax, I'll make it. Alive. Probably.

ru: Я там уже был. Не понравилось.

en: He put up a decent fight.
Cap, don't cheap out on the medal.

ru: Свет мой, зеркальце... А, это вы.

en: My good side is the left.
Did someone call for a savior?
Banner in hand. Where's the foe?

ru: Кэп, вы не видели мой плащ?
en: Cap, have you seen my cape?

ru: Вперёд, к славе! И к укрытию.
en: Onward to glory! And to cover.
A hero's path is thorny. And muddy.
Lead on, Cap! Not too far.
That's a line in the ballad.
Yes, yes, I'm magnificent. I know.
Don't crease the cape, it's formal.

ru: Ещё раз, и я спою балладу.
en: Once more and I'll sing a ballad.
The night is dark, but I shine.
Say the word and it's done.
What an honor. What a noise.
Just say where the dragon is.

ru: Я бы сразился. Но чайник кипит.
en: I'd fight. But the kettle's boiling.
Save the world. After feeding the cat.
Taxes. Now there's a real foe.
Heart of a lion. Knee of an old man.
Start the chronicle. This'll be pretty.
A hero's step is firm and fair.
Don't stray from the path, Cap.

ru: Хоть в огонь. Не в грязь.

en: To new deeds. At a walk.
If I trip, it's a maneuver.
Going. Dragon, beware! Oh, a mouse.
Ah, how the wind tousles my hair!

ru: У меня дома ещё дел полно.
en: I've got chores waiting at home.

ru: У меня и петух злее тебя.
en: My rooster is meaner than you.
Well, I'm listening. Spit it out.

ru: Тут я, кэп. Не на огороде.
en: Here, Cap. Not in the garden.
Not scared of work. Go on.
I'd rather be milking the cow.
Oh, it's you. Go on then.

ru: Иду. Не по пашне, и то ладно.

en: I know the way, don't teach me.
I'll get there. Not my first run.
Like a hog before the feast.
I got it the first time.
Want a ladle to the head?
Just like my husband. Quit it.
So much to do, and he pokes.

ru: Ещё раз, и в погреб запру.
en: Once more and it's the cellar.
Hands are wet. Make it quick.
Talk before the dough runs off.

ru: У меня суп на огне. Говори.

en: Don't pester me over nothing, Cap.
I'm here, warm as a stove.
What do I do? Spell it out.
Well, at least not the field.
Out with it. I don't bite.

ru: По хозяйству мастер. И по горлу.
en: I'm good at housework. And throats.

ru: Моя бабка воевала. Я не хуже.
en: My gran fought. I'm no worse.

ru: Кэп, а борщ ты варить умеешь?

en: Nobody commands like that in a village.
The pie cools while I'm here.

ru: Я и корову, и бандита усмирю.
en: I can calm a cow or a bandit.

ru: Ужин сварила бы за это время.
en: I'd have cooked dinner by now.
Going. Just take off my apron.
Going. Hope not to wet my hem.
Running like after a runaway hen.
Going. Leaving the bread for later.
I know the trail. Won't get lost.
Walking. Whoever needs me will catch up.
While I'm gone, keep the fire.
Fine. Won't fall in a well.

ru: Иду. И не такие тропки видала.

en: I said I'd get there, so I will.

ru: Если что, я за хлебом пошла.
en: If anything, I went for bread.
Would be faster. Without the skirt.
Going. Husband said don't be heroic.
Going. The goat will miss me.
Running like to a wedding. Someone else's.

ru: У меня ноги с поля. Крепкие.

en: I trust it's a worthy occasion.
If it's muddy, I'll be cross.
Pardon me, I'm in a hurry.

ru: Я не фарфоровая. Но всё же.
Я с первого раза поняла, милый.
en: I understood the first time, dear.

ru: Я не из тех, кто ждёт.

en: Say it, and I'll do it elegantly.
Giving orders again? What an honor.
I need a reason. A good one.
It won't be boring. I know.
My gloves cost more than you.
Fan full of bullets. Joking. Almost.
If I die, the dress goes to a museum.
Going. Wait for me round the corner.
A stroll through the battlefield. Lovely.
Going. Is the path decent? We'll see.
Going. Don't gawk at my legs.

ru: Иду. Сделаю вид, что не спешу.

en: I'll walk through mud. For you.
Going like a queen. No crown.
If I fall, you saw nothing.
Meet an enemy, I'll introduce him.

ru: Меня ждёт карета. Увы, не здесь.
en: A carriage awaits. Alas, not here.

ru: Шаг, ещё шаг. Как в вальсе.
Сейчас посмотрим, что у тебя там.

en: Got brains? What if I find some?
Don't resist. You'll tire yourself out.
You already asked. In your head.
Yes, yes... I hear you already.
Eyes in place. All of them.
Why'd you call? Oh, I know.
Path's clear. Mostly. I can tell.
You'll change your mind. Going anyway.

ru: Ты об этом не подумал. А я да.
en: You didn't think of that. I did.
I'll answer when you finish thinking.
Again? It's boring in your head.

ru: Ещё раз, и прочту твой дневник.
en: Again and I read your diary.
Hold on, you're drowning my thoughts.
So much noise in heads here.
I already answered. In my head.

ru: Говори уже. Я слышу не всё.

en: Noise in my head. Not yours.
There's an echo in your head.
Don't think of a pink elephant.
I'm a telepath, not a shrink.
I have ears in my head.

ru: Ты думаешь, что я думаю. Стоп.

en: Curious. You're not thinking at all.

ru: Я иду, а в голове гул.
en: I'm going, and my head hums.
I sense the path. It's damp.
Following the noise in my head.
Fine. I'll go listen to the walls.
Moving before you change your mind.
Going. My legs heard the order.

ru: Я не бегаю. Я телепортирую мысль.
en: I don't run. I teleport thought.

ru: Иду. Попутчиков не нужно. Мыслей тоже.
en: Going. No companions. No thoughts either.
Going. Tell the thoughts I'm busy.

ru: Иду, как в тумане. В чужом.
en: Walking as in fog. Someone else's.
I got it. No need to speak.
Don't hide your thoughts. I can see.

ru: Я б забыла. Но слишком смешно.
en: I'd forget. But it's too funny.

ru: Да. Я знаю, чего ты хочешь.
en: Yes. I know what you want.
Cap. Your thoughts got here first.
Going. Don't follow me in your head.
I hear who's round the corner. Going.
Don't think. It's bad for you.

ru: Я поняла. Ещё в прошлый раз.

en: Is your finger thinking for you?
Once more and I dig deeper.
You repeat a thought. It's stale.
Speak clearly. Your thoughts are sloppy.
My mind is busy. I'll free it.
I'm here. That's a lot already.
I know your thought. It's old.
There's a draft in your head.

ru: Не бойся. Я читаю только лишнее.
en: Don't worry. I read only the excess.
I can return your thoughts. Later.
I might forget why you called.
Your mind's an open book. Dull.

ru: Не думай про сыр. Уже думаешь.
en: Don't think of cheese. You are.
Better stay quiet. I know it already.
Going. It smells of someone's fear.
Going. Keep your thoughts to yourself.
Following the trail of others' thoughts.
I'll pass. I see the path better.
Going. Try not to be nervous.
Going. Thoughts like cotton wool. Awful.
Going. If I trip, forget it.

ru: Могу пройти сквозь стену. Не хочу.
en: I could pass through a wall. Won't.

ru: Иду. Не думай, как я иду.
en: Going. Don't think how I walk.

ru: Иду. Если что, я вам снилась.
en: Going. If anything, I was your dream.

ru: Иду. Три шага — и забыла зачем.

en: I'll go. I advise you too.
Stop poking up there. I can see.
Reached the pedals. Now hang on!
What? I'm busy. Kidding, go on.
Ooh, a job? What's it pay?
Night's my time. What's the plan?
Got an idea. Dangerous. Like it?
What are we selling today, Cap?
Moving in the dark. Like home.
Going. I'll send the bill later.
I don't shoot for free. Fine, I do.
Does this thing kick? Let's see!
Every click costs a coin, Cap.

ru: Ещё раз — и я продам мышку.
en: Once more and I sell your mouse.
I hear you, I hear you!
Are you stuck on the controls?
Enough. I'm not a squeaky toy.
Don't touch the buttons, they're mine!
What are we blowing up today?
Give a discount and I'll listen.
I see you. Just don't lean over.

ru: Не шуми, у меня тут схема.
en: Keep it down, I'm on a schematic.
Here I am. Small but mean.
There, where it's dark. Love it.
Grab something valuable on the way.
Cap, I improved a few things.
We'll find the spare parts later.
Will it blow? Of course it will.
I'm not a button. Look lower.
Cap! I've got a new blueprint!
Yes? Let me wipe my hands.
Cap, look, my eyebrows grew back!
I'll tighten something on the way.
Going, going. Ease off the throttle.
Shortest way's through the wall. Kidding.
Let's see what's left of him.
Are you broken? Let me fix you.
I hear you! Not deaf. Yet.

ru: Ещё раз — и разберу на детали.
en: Once more and I strip you for parts.

ru: Это не я дымлю. Это мотор.
en: That's not me smoking. That's the engine.
Cap, I've got an idea. Terrible one.

ru: Громче, у меня в ушах звенит!
Кэп, ты вовремя. Держи вот это.

en: Go on, I'm ready for anything.

ru: Ну вот, а я только начала.

en: Don't rush, I'm not oiled yet.
If I fall, it's a maneuver.
Whoever's in the way is spare parts.
I'll check what's broken on the way.

ru: Кэп, а рыба на ужин будет?
en: Cap, is there fish for dinner?
Listening. Make it quick, I'm bored.
There? Is it at least warm?
If the head fits, I fit.
Don't run. That makes it fun.
I'm not a ball of yarn.
I got it. I'm just ignoring you.
I'll nap right here. Watch me.
Talk before I change my mind.
Cap, right on time as usual.
You smell like fish. I like it.
I've got a nose for trouble.
Wind in my ears. Love it.
I'll run before I change my mind.
I'll run along the very edge.

ru: Чего надо? Я ничего не брала.

en: Touch me again and I bite.
Cap, we found it. Found it.
What're you staring at? I'm clean.
Got a job? I love jobs.
I smell cops. Oh, it's you.
Going. Through the shadows, as usual.
I'll get through. Locks don't stop me.

ru: Вдоль стенки. Камеры меня не любят.
en: Along the wall. Cameras hate me.
Strolling. Like I own the place.
You asked for it, pretty boy.
Gonna clean you out. To the bone.

ru: Ещё раз — и кошелёк твой мой.
en: Once more and your wallet's mine.
Why the fuss? I didn't do anything!
Poking like a guard with a baton.

ru: Мур. Это не ласка, это угроза.
en: Purr. That's a threat, not affection.
A job worth it? Then yes.
Hear you, hear you. Keep it down.
Don't rush, Cap. I'm a cat.

ru: Не пугай, я и так нервная.

en: I'm no maid. But I'm listening.
I'll come in from the yard.
Off I go. Won't leave tracks.
There? Even to the world's end.
Fine. But you owe me dinner.
Be there soon. Don't look for me.
I'll swipe something on the way.
Don't worry, I won't get caught.
Luck to me. Or to you.
My target. Don't scare it off.
I hear better than you, Captain.
Now you'll learn who's the hunter.
One shot. That's all it takes.
Poking me gives away our position.

ru: Ещё раз — пойдёшь в разведку сам.
en: Once more and you scout yourself.
I know how to heal. Behave.
One sec, let me cap this jar.
I'm here. Don't open the bag.
Going. I'll pick herbs on the way.
There? It's damp. Good for mushrooms.
On my way. With my basket.
Fine, just not through the nettles.
A cure for living. No prescription.

ru: Кэп, я не сироп от кашля.

en: Poke me again, you get an enema.
I heard. I heard it all.
Got a twitch? I can treat that.
Purr... I mean, leave me be.
Click again and it goes in your tea.
What do you need? Don't fret.
I heal with soul. And powder.
Give me your hand. I'll check the pulse.
Listening to you. And the herbs.
No panic. I'm a doctor. Almost.
St. John's wort is special today.
Going. I'll wait by the bushes.
I'll be quick. Hold the bag.
I'll come right over. Don't worry.
I'll make it, don't be afraid.
I'm a doctor. I'll make it.
Going to help. Whom? We'll see.
Hm? Ogre was thinking about soup.
Big one here. Small one gives orders.
Walking. Stay out from under feet.

ru: Ещё раз — Огр сядет. На кэпа.
en: Once more, Ogre sits. On Cap.
You like a fly. But Cap.
All good. What do you need?
No need to shout, I hear.
Here I am. Won't get lost.
Life is simple. So's an order.
I can't be quick. I do well.

ru: Что за шум? А, это ты.

en: A clear order is a good order.
I hear. Don't yell in my ear.
A far road is a long one.
Will the bridge hold? We'll see.
Can't run far. Shall we check?
Hands off. I'm not a belt.
Cap, they gave me boots again.
Speak, Cap. The tail doesn't bite.
Was sunning on a rock. What now?
I see you. Smell you too.
One bite. That's all it takes.
Want a tail to the face?
I'll coil round you in a sec.
Leaving a trail. You won't get lost.
Going. Don't stare at the tail.
I'll be there. Wait with a smile.
Hurrying. Like a snake in the sun.
Go around. I'm all over here.
Told you not to step there.

ru: У вас выход для длинных есть?
en: Got an exit for long people?

ru: Грелся на камне. Ну что там?
en: Was basking on a rock. What now?
Go on, the tail will catch up.
About to bite. Won't hurt. Mostly.
Once more and I slither off.

ru: Слышу я. Ушей нет, но слышу.
en: I hear you. No ears, but I hear.
Happy to help. If it's short.
Yeah, hear you. Keep it down.
Don't make noise, I dozed off.

ru: Я не из отряда. Но слушаю.
en: I'm not in the squad. But listening.
I'll do it and return to my rock.
I'll warm up later. Going now.
For you, even under a bridge.
No panic, I'll be there soon.
I'll do it. You cool down.
Cap? I like this. I think.
I'm here. No need to shout.
Path accepted. The detour was better.
Heading out. Cooling on the move.
Don't wait for me. Wait for results.
My core's heating. So are you.
Aim is precise. So is my grudge.
One more click and I'll sulk.
Stop. I'm not a button. Mostly.
Fans at max. That's your doing.
If I trip, it's a test.
Don't worry. Not painful at first.

ru: Зачем ты меня всё время трогаешь?
en: Why do you keep touching me?
Shh. I was counting to a hundred.
May I have a new dress?

ru: Ты пришёл за мной. Как мило.
en: You came for me. How sweet.

ru: Я не спала. Куклы не спят.
en: I wasn't asleep. Dolls don't sleep.
Step by step. Without a sound.

ru: Иду. Не смотри мне в спину.
en: Going. Don't stare at my back.
Hold still. I'll draw you a smile.
I have thread. And a needle.
Once more and I'll be upset.

ru: Ты не умеешь играть с куклами.
en: You don't know how to play with dolls.
Put me back in my box.
The tea went cold. Never mind.
Don't rush. My legs are small.
Are you a kind owner, Captain?
I'm listening with all my porcelain.
Tell me I'm a good girl.
Little legs, but they'll get there.
I'll go before I change my mind.
Where it's dark. I like it.
I'll get there. Dolls are stubborn.
If I fall, pick up the pieces.
Don't trust the silence. It's me.
Going to look at the toys.
Don't look at the seams. Going.
The doll goes for a walk.
Long walk? The strings are taut.

ru: Я уже у тебя за спиной.

en: I can see you. Even there.

ru: У тебя за плечом кто-то. Шучу.
Я всегда рядом. Просто не видно.

en: I'm not here. But I'm listening.

ru: Ты меня не видишь. Они тоже.
en: You can't see me. Neither can they.
I'm awake. If this isn't a dream.

ru: Пол не скрипнет. Не подо мной.
en: The floor won't creak. Not for me.
Come to me. Don't be afraid.
Don't scream. No one will hear.
Your hand goes right through, Cap.
Keep clicking. I'll haunt your dreams.
I got it. Back when I was alive.

ru: Ещё раз — и я в твоей каюте.
en: Once more and I'm in your cabin.
Easy, Cap. Don't scare the night.
Say the word and I vanish.
A task? I'm all for it.
A whisper is a weapon too.
I'd hug you, but I'd slip through.
Draft in your cabin? That's me.
I can fetch friends. Dead ones.
Afterlife boredom. Give me a job.
The ghost listens. Don't be scared.
I'll pass where the living can't.
If the floor falls, I'm fine.
Don't lock the door. Won't help.
Passing through a wall, I apologize.
I died there once. Dull place.
Hello to the living. For now.

ru: Пройду там, где никто не дышит.

en: I'd apologized to the wall already.
I am in the wall already. Nearly.
You're a bad person. I like it.
Hand over your soul, or need help?
Oh! Another familiar face down there.
Heh. Called for the horned one?
Bored. Give me someone to eat.
Road to hell? I know a shortcut.
Want a tail to the face?
Every click goes on your tab.
Cap, you're like a petty imp.
Leave off. I'm thinking evil thoughts.
I like it here. Lots of sins.

ru: Чёрт, а ты неплох. Для живого.
en: Damn, not bad. For a living one.
A trail of embers behind me.
Path to hell? I know it.
Smoke ahead. I'll handle the rest.
Going. Don't step on the tail.
One tail flick and I'm there.
Who burned the rug? Not me.
Sinning there? Then at a run.
Surrender. Makes no difference to me.
I heard you the first time.
Button won't break. My patience will.
That one gives no more orders.

ru: Столько мяса. И всё с оружием.
Не ори. Я ещё не начал.
У меня нет чувств. Есть гнев.
Не нажимай. Гнев и так полный.
en: Don't click. Anger is full already.
Sense of humor: file not found.
I love the job. That's a bug.
Course set. The rest is trash.
I walk better than I get people.
Order accepted. No one to appeal to.
I'll check behind the armor too.
Repeat orders move you up the list.
Step by step. To the condemned.
Coming. Let them hear my steps.
One more click. You're on the list.
No need to repeat. I remember.
Name the guilty. I'll find them.
Say the word. The rest is mine.
The iron hand of law listens.

ru: Судьи нет. Адвоката нет. Есть я.
en: No judge. No lawyer. Just me.
Shackles issued. The rest is you.
The list is long. Patience suffices.
The hand of law is present.
The path leads to the block.
Let them hear. Let them wait.
Escort deployed. A party of one.
Heading to court. Under my own power.
Won't run. I'll still catch you.
I walk well. I execute better.
A walk before an execution. Not mine.

ru: Могу и в обход. Не хочу.
en: I could go around. I won't.

ru: Я не бегу. Бегут от меня.
en: I don't run. They run from me.

ru: Иду к месту казни. Путь знаю.

en: I'm old. The bullets are new.
Route plotted. Obstacles will be removed.
Target locked. Thank you for waiting.

ru: Ваш звонок очень важен для нас.
en: Your call is important to us.
Thanks for choosing the old model.
Speak slower. The model is old.
Repeat the request. Hearing is off.
Don't press hard. The case is fragile.
Can kill. Can fix a tap.
Repair the enemy? Only with a bullet.

ru: Жизнь в норме. В смысле, питание.

en: Don't fear the noise. It's the motor.

ru: Кофе мне не нужен. Масла бы.

en: Relocation takes a little. A lot.
Moving. Don't jostle an old unit.
My map is paper. Never mind.
Your route was calculated. By me.
Don't fall behind. Kidding. I'm slow.
Going. The wheels know the job.

ru: Следую по пути. Спасибо за ожидание.

en: I'll arrive. I'm used to it.
Reporting in. From around the corner.
Yes, master. Made a mess again?
Hold still. The stain is spreading.
Yes, master. Rag at the ready.
Smiling. It's part of the service.
Master, you've got something on you.
Going. I'll wipe along the way.

ru: Иду. Пыль сама себя не сметёт.
en: On my way. Dust won't sweep itself.
Of course. Wipe your feet there.
This trash won't take itself out.
I'll remove you. Like a stain.
Excuse me, this is a cleaning zone.
Once more and I polish you.
Smells of disorder. I can tell.
Allow me to wipe your face.
No dust here. Soon there will be.
My brushes are full of energy.
I can even clean you away.
Please don't stand on the wet.
Face to the floor again? Habit?
Your smile is sloppy. I'll fix it.

ru: Я работаю без выходных. Очень рада.
en: I work without days off. Delighted.
The floor shines. Like my smile.
Every speck of dust is logged.
Say the word, I'll be invisible.

ru: Если что, у меня есть швабра.
en: If anything, I have a mop.
I'll mop the floor en route.
Of course. Not across the carpet.
One foot is cleaner than the other.
Pardon me. I've got a bucket.
I'll grab the broom and go.

ru: Вот так путь. Весь в пыли.
en: What a path. Covered in dust.
If it's dirty there, I'm happy.
Going to clean. With a smile.
If I trip, I'll mop the floor.
The whole way is stained. Horror.

ru: Грязь не пройдёт. И я тоже.
en: Dirt shall not pass. Nor shall I.
There? It needs a deep clean.
I'll be quick. Just dust off.
It'll all shine. Or fall silent.
Familiar face. Shot at it before.
You're not on the list. Removing.
I don't blink. That's a feature.
No sleeping allowed. I see you.
Dust on the lens. That's you.

ru: Свет в объективе. Это не любовь.
en: Light in the lens. Not love.
The stroll is part of service.
I'll do it. Hands work now.
Come closer. See my new parts.

ru: Не стучи. Там и так замыкает.
en: Don't knock. It already shorts out.
Half my pay goes on oil.
Me again? Wear level: eighty percent.
I hear you. Ears are metal too.

ru: Ещё щелчок — и я в спящий режим.
en: One more click and I go to sleep.

ru: Я не ворчу. Это шум фана.
en: I'm not grumbling. It's fan noise.
I'm human. Forty percent or so.
Used to walk. Now it's better.

ru: Мозг в облаке. Тело в долгу.
en: Brain in the cloud. Body in debt.
Keep out of the socket. Live.
Order me. I'm supposed to endure.

ru: Кофе не пью. Мне нужен хладагент.

en: Going. Drive complains, so do I.
Off I go. Grease in reserve.
Legs sufficed once. Now a drive.
Going. If I fall, fix me.

ru: Вперёд. Железо не устаёт. Я — да.
en: Forward. Iron never tires. I do.
Route is theirs. Legs are mine.
Motion started. If we break, repair.
Going. My back isn't iron. Almost.
I'll do it. Just stay clear.

ru: Капитан, я здесь не для красоты.
Совершенство не ждёт. Но я подожду.

en: I'll get through. Nothing stops me.
You were a mistake. I'll correct it.
Look at me. One last time.

ru: Я всё слышала с первого раза.
en: I heard you the first time.

ru: Ещё раз — и я перестану отвечать.

en: Is the order worth my time?
I'll do better than you ask.

ru: Всё идёт как надо. Моими стараниями.
en: All goes well. Thanks to me.
Don't worry. I'm near. For now.
No fuss. I have a schedule.
Going. The rest will catch up. Maybe.
The floor beneath me is mine.
Don't trip while staring at me.

ru: Иду, но не бегу. Не к лицу.

en: A fine goal. I'll grace it.
Hands off. Not that you can.

ru: В жизни я ещё лучше. Шучу.

en: I do have feelings. Rendered ones.
Gliding. The legs are for show.
Your finger goes right through, Cap.
Stop it, I'm starting to flicker.

ru: Это экран. Я там не живу.
en: That's a screen. I don't live there.

ru: Ещё клик — и я стану заставкой.
en: One more click and I'm a screensaver.

ru: Всё ещё здесь. Всё ещё я.

en: I won't cast a shadow. Sorry.
Don't worry, I'll be back. Probably.
I'll go around people. I'm polite.

ru: Не двигайся. Мне за попадания платят.
en: Don't move. I get paid for hits.
Taking prisoners? Is there extra pay?

ru: На месте. Аванс тоже на месте?
en: Here. Is the advance here too?
Every shot's a line on the bill.
See the target. Smell the money.
I'm not deaf. I'm a merc.
Poke me again, I'll invoice you.
Got it first time. Second costs extra.
I'm not in it for ideals.
Got ammo. Got the bill too.
Moving. Don't shoot me in the back.
Even to hell, if it pays.

ru: Я здесь. Ты меня не видишь.
en: I'm here. You just can't see me.
He's asleep. Let him stay that way.
A knife's quieter than a bullet.
Got it. Got it back then.
Nobody called me. But I'm listening.
Back into the dark? Love it.
Here I am. Now I'm not.
If you hear me, that's bad.
I'll creep up from the other side.
Leaving. Don't follow with your eyes.
Fixing it? Or straight to explosives?
Hold on. Let me look closer.
Return my tools. I'll wash them later.
Spare screw here. I'll keep it.
I'll plot a route. Through the wall.

ru: Не стучи по корпусу. Не поможет.

en: Once more and I unplug you.
Give me a minute. Or two.
If it works, don't touch it.
Need a specialist? Here he is.
Going. I'll check it's not mined.
I'll break something on the way.
Going. If anything, I'll fix it.
On the way. Spare parts clinking.
Going to break. I mean fix.

ru: Я пошёл. Не трогайте мой ящик.
en: Off I go. Hands off my box.
I'll take you and the cover.

ru: Чего зовёшь? Тут всё ещё стреляет.
en: Why call? Stuff's still shooting here.
I'll fit. We'll move the wall.
Got walls? Then I got work.
Out of the way, I'm heavy.

ru: Я и так иду. Тяжело иду.

en: Again and I break the button.
I need an exit. Or entrance.
Tight in here. We'll widen it.
If it's in the way, gone.
I'm in place. Not for long.
Taking my place. All of it.
Right. Who screwed up this time?
Move out. Don't die one by one.

ru: Жми его. За это и платят.
en: Push him. That's what you're paid for.
Heard the order. Need it repeated?
Listening. Fast and to the point.
Fall in. At least in your head.
Misses come out of your pay.
I got it. I'm not stupid.
I'm a boss. Not a nanny.
I'm captain, not an info desk.
Listening. For now I tolerate it.
Did you even read the order?
I count the steps. Every one.
We get there, we sort it out.
Get to work. Money won't earn itself.
Leave conscience to the cheaper mercs.

ru: Пункт первый: не тратить моё время.
en: Clause one: don't waste my time.
Fine. The position will be taken.
Going. Let them see who pays.
He broke the terms. Of living.
One more touch is a fine.
You've come to the right place.
I'm ready to take the report.
Going. Have them prep a report.
Yes. I will carry it out.
Hold still. You'll ruin the data.
Lost my train of thought. Again.
I have a hypothesis. And a pistol.
Let's test the hypothesis. With fire.

ru: Это для науки. Ну и для меня.
en: This is for science. And for me.
You distracted me from a discovery.
Going. I'll measure on the way.
I'll collect data on the way.
Going. Let me calculate the step.

ru: Что у нас на этот раз?

en: I'm a medic, not a button!
Who cleaned a gun with my bandages?

ru: Говори. Только не кашляй на меня.
en: Talk. Just don't cough on me.
Got the kit. Not the patience.
You again? Where does it hurt?
Time for a shot. A lead one.
Oath's an oath. Still gotta shoot.
I'm not a blood pressure cuff.
Patch you up? Or as is?
Going. Let me catch a breath.
At a run! Well, a walk.
To the end of the world? Fine.
Going. Just a sip of water.

ru: Я слышу. Даже если ты молчишь.
en: I hear you. Even when you're silent.

ru: Давай я сама решу за тебя.

en: I already know why you're here.
Listening. Not just with my ears.
Fine. The path is clear. For now.

ru: Перемещаюсь. Не спорь сам с собой.

en: Yes. I knew before you said it.
He's afraid. As he should be.

ru: Я слышала. Ещё в прошлый раз.

en: Shall I show what you just thought?
Wait. Let me finish reading you.
Faith's with me. And a shotgun.
Heaven is watching. So am I.
Who called the warrior of faith?

ru: Иду. Ересь сама себя не сожжёт.

en: Lead me, captain. Like a prophet.
In the name of! You know.
Patience is a virtue. Not mine.
Once more and you're doing penance.
A word for me? Go on.
Who's in the shadow of sin?
God was patient. So will I.
Going. There's light at the end.
Here's a blessing. A strong one.
Rest already. Stop getting in the way.
The hammer's blessed. So am I.
Here. Stand straight when you call.
Time for a lesson. A heavy one.
Once more and it's a hundred bows.
Peace be with you. For now.
I hear. No need to shout.
The order is on the line.
Sister listens. Don't drag it out.
Yes, captain. God be with us.
I serve the faith. And you.
I was thinking of eternity. What?
The stairs to heaven are steep.
I'll hitch my robe and go.
Don't rush. Haste is a sin.
My feet ache, my faith doesn't.
A clean path for holy feet.
God willing, I'll arrive. I will.
The Lord hears. I hear when I like.
Brought an offering? Then I'm listening.
My path is righteous. Even this one.
Going. Don't step on my robe.
I absolve you. All at once.

ru: Ещё раз — и проповедь на час.
en: Again and it's an hour-long sermon.
Heard. From above, and by me.

ru: Свет с тобой. Пока я рядом.
en: Light be with you. While I'm near.

ru: Ты по делу или по грехам?

en: I was musing on eternity. Well?
Speak. God can wait, I can't.
I won't receive you without confession.
Need help from above? I'm closer.
The shepherd has come. Speak up.

ru: Иди с миром. Нет, стой. Что?
en: Go in peace. No, stay. What?
It's all in the heavenly book.

ru: Не кричи. Мы не на ярмарке.
en: Don't shout. This isn't a fair.
The Lord sent me. Well, nearly.
What need of a holy word?
Look at me. I am the light.
I'll arrive. The Lord will carry.
To walk is not to sit. Familiar.
The way is thorny. My robe, alas.
Going. The choir sings behind me.
Feet are the servants of faith.
Don't push. A holy man here.
The holy father's on the way.
Going. To bring light, so be it.

ru: Вперёд, и да поможет нам Господь.
en: Onward, and the Lord help us.
What do you want? Shop's closed.
Away from the goods. I'm coming.
Put it down. Stay in one piece.
Take him out. Check the pockets first.
Break it, pay for it. Even dead.
You again? Show me a receipt.
Fine. Warehouse is unguarded, mind you.
Going. Damage goes on your tab.

ru: Я на смене, а не на побегушках.
en: I'm on shift, not your errand boy.
Once more and you're escorted out.
I got it. Security isn't deaf.
Warehouse is fine. What d'you want?
A hundred years on post. Listening.
Does the boss know you're here?
Post taken. What do you need?
Good goods are guarded. By me.
Oh, go on. Out with it.
Keep the light on, I'm going.
Going for a walk with the baton.
Don't shut the door behind me.
On my round. Don't miss me.
The post won't run. I'll go.
Call if anything. I won't answer.
Going, but give my bonus back.
Duck. This isn't a drill anymore.

ru: Багаж за вас воевать не будет.
en: Your luggage won't fight for you.
Good day! How may I help?
I'll be right there. One moment.
The call button isn't a toy.

ru: Ещё раз — и сниму с рейса.
en: Once more and you're off the flight.
Need a blanket? Or a shield?
How do you like our service?

ru: Иду по проходу. Тележка со мной.
en: Walking the aisle. Cart in tow.
Quick as a flash. Don't miss me.
Heels are high, but I'll make it.

ru: Шаг за шагом, как в инструкции.
en: Step by step, per the manual.
Don't drink the water, just in case.
Yes? Is it urgent or expensive?
I'll handle it. Leave the goods alone.

ru: Убрать. Он нам ничего не купит.
en: Remove him. He won't buy anything.

ru: Теперь проверьте, что у него было.
en: Now check what he was carrying.
Pirates alive? Will insurance cover it?
Listening. Is my time paid for?
The Guild is on the line.
Yes. A deal or a chat?
Writing him off as a loss.
Every touch goes on the bill.
To what do I owe? Not a debt.
Don't rush. I'm in a hurry.
You owe me. But I'm listening.
A cigar for me. I'm listening.
I hear. But hearing will cost.
Going. Put it in the estimate.
On foot to a bright future.
A deal is a deal. Going.
Threat removed. We'll count the damage.
Heard the order. Let me do it.
Surviving is in the company's interest.
Marsec service. What do you need?
I'll file a complaint with HR.
Helmet on. What do you need?
No coffee in the manual. Listening.
The air is busy. But listening.
I hear the order. Not opinions.
It's in my job description. Going.
Book him. He won't run now.

ru: Руки вверх! Ну, или как хочешь.

en: That was the warning shot. I think.
You have the right to stay silent. Forever.
Once more and you're in the tank.
I'm the police. Who are you?
The law is coming. Step aside.
The case smells of scandal. Going.
The station will cope without me.
Fine. But give me a bonus.
I'll check. Stay where you are.
You're not supposed to be here.

ru: Если спросят — нас здесь не было.

en: Access confirmed. What do you need?
Keep the route off the log.
Going. Lock the doors behind me.

ru: Ещё раз — и в отдел кадров.
en: Once more and it's HR for you.
The doors will open on their own.

ru: Я не уходил. Ты не заметил.
en: I never left. You didn't notice.
I see in the dark. You don't.

ru: Ты не видел, как я ушёл.

en: I'm here. Looking the wrong way.
I'll get closer. He won't notice.
Don't touch. You'll expose us both.
Captain, sneaking or making a racket?
I've been behind you for ages.
I'll slip by. He won't blink.
He's looking the wrong way. Cute.
I got it. The first time.

ru: Ещё раз — и спрячусь от тебя.
en: Again and I'll hide from you.
Oh, you caught me. Well, speak.

ru: Не люблю шум. Но тебя слушаю.
en: Don't like noise. But I listen to you.
Oh. I was lost in thought. What?
Knife is sharp. So is my tongue.
Don't scare me. I'm the scary one.
Here I am. Right behind you.
Sneak up with a kiss. Joke.
I'll go warm up my knives.
Off I ran. Don't miss me.
Put the gun down, smart guy!
Poke again and get one back.

ru: Это не кража. Он сам оставил.
en: Not theft. He left it there.
Got a job? Where's my cut?

ru: Я тут ни при чём. Честно.

en: Going. I'll look around on the way.
I got it, I got it!
Once more, there's a fine. Paid to me.

ru: Слышь, не трожь, а то укушу.
en: Hey, hands off or I bite.
They're a bit scared of me here.
I'm a big shot around here.
Not in front of people, got it?
My boys are on their way.

ru: Я с утра не ел. Злой.

en: I'm no thief. I'm a gatherer.
Mom said be yourself. So here.

ru: У меня справка, что я опасный.
en: I've a note saying I'm dangerous.
Be right back. Don't miss me.
If asked, I was out walking.

ru: Бегу! Не от кого-то. Просто бегу.
en: Running! Not from anyone. Just running.

ru: Иду на дело. Вернусь с долей.
en: Off to a job. Back with a cut.
I'm going there too. By chance.
Whose ground are you standing on?
Had quite the attitude, didn't he?
Hand off. While you have one.
Listening. I'm in a good mood.
Make way, the boss is coming.

ru: Я тебя с первого раза понял.
en: I heard you the first time.

ru: Ещё раз ткнёшь — запишу в долг.
en: Poke again, it goes on your tab.
Nobody's called me in a while.

ru: Без меня тут ничего не движется.

en: I have an offer for you.
I'm a family man. You get it.

ru: Ты вовремя. Я как раз скучал.

en: My suit costs more than your house.

ru: Налоги я не отдаю. Я собираю.
en: I don't pay taxes. I collect them.
Boss on the line. Others later.
I'll come. I like a close look.
I'll go say hi to everyone.
I don't go there. Today I will.
I'm coming. Save me a seat.
Let's go while I'm in a good mood.
Red carpet for me. Imaginary will do.
Every step of mine is money.
I used to be carried. Now I walk.

ru: Это не маршрут. Это моя улица.
en: It's not a route. It's my street.
Floor it! Brakes are for wimps!

ru: Ну чего тыкаешь, я ж еду!

en: Once more and I run you over!

ru: Бензин на нуле, а я нет.

en: Loud, fun, just how I like.
My brakes are other people's screams.
Best driver around. Ask the wall.

ru: Кто там сзади? А, это пыль.

en: Don't worry, I almost know how.
Don't hold me, I'm already revving.

ru: Бегу. Я ж не за рулём.

en: If I crash, it was a manoeuvre.

ru: Я не бегу. Я иду очень быстро.
en: I'm not running. I walk very fast.
Move over or I'll clip you.

ru: Я здесь. По запаху не чуешь?

en: In we go. Already filthy anyway.
It'll wash off. If you're lucky.
What? I'm here, in the puddle.
I got it. I got it.
Once more and I'll hug you.
Everything's slippery. Get used to it.
Don't step in the puddle. Mine.

ru: Ты тоже весь в тине? Нет?

en: Quiet. I'm listening to the swamp.
I'm clean. It's just the colour.
Bathed this morning. In a ditch.
Told to wash. I took offence.

ru: Я не грязная. Я с историей.
en: I'm not dirty. I've got history.
Frogs know me. And respect me.
Don't touch the slime. It's mine.
Keep up or it sucks you in.
Dry there? I'll bring my own swamp.
Going. Let the clean freaks wait.
Stomping before it sucks me in.
I'll get there. After a soak.

ru: Не бойся, это не я. Это лужа.

en: They say mud's harmful. Didn't listen.
Going. I can't be washed anymore.

ru: Поджечь? А что ты сразу не сказал!
en: Burn it? Why didn't you say so!
I'll go warm the place up.
Got it, dear. I'll burn it all.
Once more and you'll get burned.
I love fire. It doesn't argue.

ru: У меня тут всё под контролем.

en: Glad to hear. What do I burn?
Don't bake pies, but I roast.

ru: Не бойся, я не кусаюсь. Горю.
en: Don't fear, I don't bite. I burn.
I've got a little flame for you.
I'm no arsonist. I'm a decorator.

ru: Мама просила не играть с огнём.
en: Mom asked me not to play with fire.
Don't breathe near me. Just in case.
Who asked to burn? Already did.

ru: Ой, а это горело? Уже нет.
en: Oh, was that burning? Not anymore.
Going. All on my path warms up.
I'll warm someone on the way.

ru: Иду. Это не дым, это я.
en: Going. That's not smoke, it's me.

ru: Иду. Спички, на всякий случай, взяла.
en: Going. Took matches, just in case.

ru: Если что-то загорится, это не я.

en: My tracks are hot. Don't step.
Hasn't burned there yet? I'll fix.

ru: Это не бегство. Это пламенный рывок.
en: Not an escape. A fiery dash.
Don't look like that, I'll ignite.
No need to negotiate after all.

ru: В долг не дам. Не тыкай.

en: Going. I know a back way.

ru: Ладно. Но это за отдельную плату.

en: Going. Dark side of the street.
Every click's on the price list.
Once more and I bill you.
I can get anything. Except conscience.

ru: У меня есть всё, что нужно.

en: I don't sell, I help. For money.
Only for friends. At a markup.
I know the right people. All.
Say what you need. I'll find it.

ru: Законы? Я их не нарушаю. Обхожу.
en: Laws? I don't break them. I detour.

ru: У меня нет склада. Склад — везде.
en: I have no warehouse. It's everywhere.
I don't say extras. Only valuables.

ru: Мой девиз: не пойман — не вор.
en: Motto: not caught, not a thief.
I'm honest. In my own way.

ru: Иду. Только не бегите с товаром.
en: Going. Don't run with the goods.
I'll go deal with the post.
Going. I'll sell something on the way.
I know a shortcut. It's paid.
We'll be there. If not stopped.
Route is secret. Even from me.

ru: Иду. Без накладной, но с душой.
en: Going. No invoice, but with soul.

ru: Не торопите. Контрабанда не любит спешки.

en: Let's go. Done working for them.
Don't sound like the previous boss.
Take the depot. Celebrate freedom later.
Here. Low on ammo, but here.
Off I go. Flag goes up later.
Fine, going. For freedom, I guess.

ru: Ещё раз — и уйду в профсоюз.
en: Once more and I join the union.
No lunch again. Used to it.
Was waiting for orders. Got them.
Here. Not a hero. But here.
I'm with you. Nowhere to go.
If only someone brought a pie.
Rebel isn't a job. It's a diagnosis.
The people are me. Pleased to meet you.
Don't shoot, I'm one of you. Mostly.

ru: Иду. Враг не дремлет, я тоже.
en: Going. Enemy doesn't sleep, nor me.
Going. I'll invent a slogan en route.

ru: Держись за мной. Я знаю тропу.
en: Stay behind me. I know the trail.

ru: За правое дело. Или за обед.
en: For a just cause. Or lunch.
Going. Time for the rest too.

ru: Иду на фронт. С пустым желудком.
en: Off to the front. On empty stomach.
If asked, I was just walking.

ru: Иду. Я тут ни при чём.
en: Going. Nothing to do with me.
I'm here. I can see it all.
Let's go. They won't surrender themselves.
Have you tried listening to me?
Let's go while they're having tea.
Moving. Make way for the people!

ru: Я ж не глухая. Я злая.
Нас всё меньше, а злости больше.

en: My hands itch. Let me shoot.
If anything, the boss is to blame.

ru: Кто там грозил расправой? Я тоже.
Революция не ждёт. А я жду.
Это моя улица. Иду по ней.

en: Going. I'll think of a slogan running.

ru: Двигаю. Кто за свободу, за мной.

en: Going. If I fall, it's a protest.

ru: Ухожу в подполье. На пять метров.

en: My walk is already a riot.
Awaiting orders. For a while now.
In the name of the law!
That was the warning. This isn't.
That's not going in the report.

ru: Я не ленюсь. Я экономлю силы.
В уставе про это ни слова.

en: Lunch in an hour. But listening.

ru: Строй не мой конёк. Я тут.
en: Formation's not my forte. Still here.
Going. I'll write the report later.

ru: Согласно приказу. Хоть и не хочу.

en: Going. Tell me if you change your mind.

ru: Двигаюсь к цели. Без лишних слов.
en: Moving to target. No extra words.
Can't hear me? I'm special forces.
Going. Ration's in the pack. Probably.
If I'm lost, track the noise.

ru: Хоть на край света. За оклад.
en: To the world's end. For a salary.
Moving. Regs allow it. Seems so.
Coming over. Don't blow anything up.
You're getting in the way of command.
Who was in charge of reconnaissance?!
Going. Note it in the log.
Once more and it's a reprimand.
You're distracting me from the war.
I'll mark it after the report.
This post has no leave. Pity.

ru: Я не жестокий. Я по регламенту.

en: My office is on another floor.
I personally approve. For the record.
I'll go in person, as usual.

ru: Иду. Печать у меня с собой.
Я не бегу. Начальство не бегает.

en: I'm entitled to a lift. None.
A walk. For health and report.
Darling, you told me everything yourself.
You want to surrender. Don't you?
Once more and I'll be offended.
You do know how to surprise.
Don't be shy. I don't judge.
You're taking a risk. I like it.
The government told me to smile.

ru: Я на службе. Но не сейчас.
en: On duty. But not right now.
Are they waiting for me there?
I'll approach from the other side.
Fine. But you owe me dinner.
If I see a tail, I'll smile.

ru: Если что — я тут не была.
en: If asked, I was never here.
Clear the way. Need a passage.
Heroes got carried off. Keep working.
I'm a soldier, not a button.
Give a clear order, I'll do it.
Waited for the signal. Here it is.
We were many. Now it's me.
A spear? No, a gun. Handier.
My red cloak's at the laundry.
A Spartan doesn't sleep. He waits.
No time to be a hero. Order.
Going. Left my shield at home.
They said the enemy was terrifying.
This is for your own good!
This violates the chain of command!
I know regulations by heart. Speak.
Order is the basis of victory.
The squad is flawless. Me included.
Speak clearly and by the form.
I'll write the report in triplicate.

ru: Иду. Если что — я не бежал.
en: Going. If asked, I didn't run.
A turn here. I meant that.
Is this it? Has it started?
Coming! Don't end it without me!

ru: Не мешай. Я конец света жду.
en: Don't interrupt. Waiting for the apocalypse.

ru: Опять не сегодня? Да сколько можно!
en: Not today again? Oh, come on!
The end is near! Feel it too?
Oh, a sign! Or just you.
End of the world, in installments!
Don't rush the end. It'll come.
Is that a sign? No? Pity.

ru: Ещё раз — и спишу в расходы.
en: Once more and I'll expense it.
I had a vision. Go on.
Hear trumpets! Or is it you?
The sunset is red. A good omen.
End of the world, brother. Rejoice.
The end smells of smoke. Love it.
The night is long. Talk fast.
End of the world. Budget approved.
Prophet on the line. Costly rate.
The end is near. Discounts too.

ru: Я не безумен. Я в штате.
en: I'm not mad. I'm on staff.
The trail leads to ash. Going.
Going to the call. Hear it?
Last step. No, second to last.
Keep up. The end will catch you.

ru: Я первый на месте. Как всегда.
en: First at the place. As always.

ru: Иду. Пепел на плечах — к счастью.

en: Boots worn out. Booking a loss.
I'll be late for the end!
A prophet doesn't run. He hurries.
While I walk, it's not the end.
I'll arrive and tell the universe.
Going. Ever closer to the end.

ru: Бегу. Костёр без меня не зажигать!
en: Running. Don't light the fire without me!
This one's done. Bring the next.
Yes, sweetie? We're out of salt.
You look a bit pale today.

ru: Что на обед? Вот и решаем.

en: I'll go. Shopping on the way.
Coming. Smells like meat over there.
Off I go. Got my spices.
Nicely marbled. Just how I like it.

ru: Ещё раз ткнёшь — пойдёшь в рагу.
en: Poke me again and you're stew.

ru: Я поняла. Не стой над душой.

en: Talk. Just not over the pot.
While I listen, the stew bubbles.
Don't come with an empty plate.

ru: Повар всегда прав. Особенно с ножом.
en: The cook's always right. Knife in hand.

ru: Мой рецепт — тайна. Как и состав.
en: My recipe's a secret. So's the filling.
Meat is pricey. Take care of yourselves.
I don't take thin ones. Hassle.
Just turn off the soup. Going.
Now. Turn off the oven and run.
Go and be back. By dinner.
Going calmly. The meat can wait.
Taking a stroll. Working up appetite.
There? Nice place. For a picnic.

ru: Только никого не ешь без меня.

en: If I meet something tasty, I catch it.

ru: Ужин сам не прыгнет в котёл.
en: Dinner won't jump in the pot.
Going. Sharpened the knife. Just in case.
Going. The garden won't water itself.
You'll get used to it too.

ru: Кэп, я бы сдох. Да поздно.
en: Cap, I'd die. Too late though.
Got rum? Just to smell it.
Going. The leg will catch up.

ru: Иди к нам. На дне места много.
en: Join us. Plenty of room below.
Poke away. Can't feel a thing.

ru: Понял я. Мозги ещё при мне. Вроде.
en: Got it. Still have brains. I think.

ru: Что за шум? А. Это я.

en: It's cold here. Or I am.
I dreamt of rum. That you?

ru: Да. Только без хлопков по плечу.

en: I'd sigh. Nothing to sigh with.
I'd whisper, but my cords rotted.
Dug myself out for you. Appreciate.
Going. Lost a finger. I'll find it.

ru: Курс на могилу. То есть туда.
en: Course to the grave. I mean there.
Going. Something'll fall off. Pick it up.
Wind whistles in my ribs. Going.
Going. If I fall, leave me.
Going. Don't forget to retrieve me.
Best walk is to the beyond.
Going. Hit me and I crumble.

ru: Мёртв, но всё ещё в строю.
Иду. Не за деньгами. За романтикой.
en: Going. Not for money. For romance.

ru: Затих. Как у нас в голове.
en: Quiet now. Like inside our head.
Don't touch us. There's plenty of us.
Who said that? Oh. Inside again.
Yes sir. Legs went on their own.

ru: Иду. Не туда хотел, но иду.
en: Going. Not where I meant, but going.
Target seen. With two sets of eyes.

ru: Иди к нам. Тесно, но тепло.

en: Heard you. Both times. All of us.
I listen. He doesn't want to.
Talk. It's noisy in my head.
Sorry. I'm not alone right now.

ru: Я в порядке. Мы в порядке.

en: Quiet in my head. Rare. Talk.
There are two of us. One ration.

ru: Он хочет выпить. Я не против.
en: He wants a drink. I'm fine with it.

ru: Иди к чёрту. Не тебе. Ему.
en: Go to hell. Not you. Him.

ru: Я устал. Он нет. Вот беда.
Иду. Он хочет бежать. Не дам.
en: Going. He wants to run. No.
Going. If only he'd shut up.
Going. He promised not to interfere.
Where? I don't know. He does.
Let the next one come in.
Fetch the master. We'll have a chat.
Listening. Leave the whip at home.
Well, here I am. No collar.
Going. On my own, no kicks.
Fine. At least not in circles.
There? Do they at least feed you?
I dropped your kind in the arena.
This one's for the years in chains.
Finish him? Or ask the crowd?
I'm not your maid. Not anymore.
Got it the first time. Habit.
Once more and I run off.

ru: Три боя за сутки. Что тебе?
en: Three fights a day. What now?
Who to kill? Or mop the floor?

ru: Контракт? Я не читаю. Я рублю.
en: Contract? I don't read. I chop.

ru: Мне бы отпуск. Хоть на неделю.
en: I need a vacation. A week at least.
Is there dinner? Or am I?

ru: Иду. Только не толкай в спину.

en: OK. But I pick the trail.
I'll go. At least breathe air.
Going. You pay for the shoes.
Going. Just tell where it ends.

ru: Двигаюсь. Следи, чтоб не в спину.

en: Running. As from the master. Habit.
Going. A pie would be nice.
Heading to the exit. My favorite.
Going. Not an escape. A stroll.
Coming over. Don't touch the specimens.
Don't worry. This won't take long.
Why does it have so much hair?
Don't move. You'll ruin the data.
Enough. I'm not the subject here.
I hear you. You hear me too.
Put the weapon down. It's in your way.

ru: Зачем опять звать? Я уже внутри.
en: Why call again? I'm already inside.
You came. I knew you would.
Look into my eyes. Don't blink.
There? As you say. For now.
Turn to your friends. Just like that.
You keep calling. I'm right here.

ru: Не так громко. Я в голове.
en: Not so loud. I'm in your head.
Don't be scared. It'll be quick.
Easier with hands. Thoughts get tangled.
Yes? I'm big. You can't miss me.
What do you want, little one?
I'll get through. Walls don't count.
Going. I'll duck if I have to.
Stay put. I'll be gentle. Almost.
Don't push. You can't move me.
Enough. I got it. Ages ago.
Once more and I sit on you.
Touch the tail again, I bite.
Speak. I taste you on the air.
Understood. Are the rocks warm there?
One strike. That's all it takes.
Got it. Don't hiss at me.

ru: Без ног, а всё равно догнал.

en: Don't pull the tubes. I'll bite.
Find me somewhere decent to land.
I see it all from up here. What?
Flying over. Walls are for you.
Cover with no roof? Big mistake.
Stop shaking. You'll kink the tubes.
I hear you. Comms are fine.

ru: Ещё раз — сяду тебе на голову.
en: Once more and I land on your head.
Have them move aside. I'm coming.
You come to me again. Of course.
I am here. I am everywhere.
I will pass. Space will yield.
Let the ground lie at my feet.
I go. Do not follow too closely.
The path is chosen. Not by you.
I need not even touch you.
Repeating it doesn't make it wiser.

ru: Ещё раз — и забудешь своё имя.
en: Once more and you forget your name.
I'll come closer. Won't let you leave.

ru: Не трогай. Могу принять за врага.
en: Don't touch. Might mistake you for enemy.
Everything on them is soft. Convenient.
I'll take a walk. Remove the rabble.
Take it away. Spoils the view.
Who allowed you to touch me?
Speak faster. I'm busy with myself.
You dare call me? Go on.
I'll go. Roll out the carpet.

ru: Иду. Не наступайте мне на тень.
en: Going. Don't step on my shadow.
Once more and you'll be flogged.
I'm not a servant. Remember that.
Coming. Sure it's not a trap?

ru: Нас мало? Ты в подвал заглядывал?
en: Not many of us? Checked the basement?

ru: Чего? Это не моё! Уже моё.
en: What? Not mine! Now it is.
Who called? Is there a reward?
Going, going. But if it's a trap...
Through the holes, in the dark.
One bite, and your stuff's mine.
There's lots of us. Just one of you.
Why poke? Want to search me?
Got it, got it. Quit tugging.
Once more, I bite. A finger.

ru: Не кидай палку! Я на службе!
en: Don't throw the stick! I'm on duty!
Run faster. More fun that way.
I see you. I'm down here.
On your knees, then we'll talk.

ru: Тут я, внизу. Смотри под ноги.

en: What? I've picked up a trail.
Off I go. Following my nose.
I hear, I hear! I'm not deaf.

ru: Ещё раз — и за ухо цапну.
en: Once more and I nip your ear.
Don't knock on the shell. I hear you.
Why does everything on you come off?
Don't click at me. That's my thing.
I'll come closer. You stay here.

ru: Иди сюда. Я не обижу. Сильно.
en: Come here. I won't hurt you. Much.

ru: Ещё раз — и ты на поводке.
en: Once more and you're on a leash.

ru: Меня трогать не входит в программу.
en: Touching me isn't part of the show.
Scream louder. They can't hear backstage.
Don't press the button. I bite.
The masters didn't ask for prisoners.

ru: Здесь стою я. Ищи другую дверь.

en: I go first. As it should be.
The masters watch. I won't miss.
I'll break it. Not promising quick.
Again and I report to the masters.

ru: Терпение у меня тоже по уставу.

en: Trying to scare me with that?
I'll hug you. You won't like it.
Poke again, I break the finger.
Enough. I'm not an elevator button.
You'll move. Or the wall will.
One eye. Still see better than you.
Don't like thinking. Give me work.
Once more and I break the button.
Hearing you. Water gets in the way.

ru: Иду к воде. Или к врагу.
en: Heading to water. Or the enemy.

ru: Не трогай. Слизь не для тебя.
en: Don't touch. Slime's not for you.

ru: Слышал. Вода в ушах, но слышал.
en: Heard you. Water in my ears, but heard.
Leave me be. I'll go back to sea.

ru: На глубине ты меньше спорил бы.

en: The bottom was waiting for you.
Don't grab. I'll drag you under.
The path is open. For me.
The dark of the deep. Look into it.
You will drown. Right on land.
The tide is patient. I am not.
Hearing you. Stop bubbling over me.
Swimming over. Don't muddy the way.
Where are you going without water?
Who turned the oxygen down again?
Target in murky water. Got it.

ru: Тут и так воды по горло.
en: I'm already in it up to my neck.
Enough. I'm not a fishing float.
Stay still. Need to measure you.
Such a big head. Empty too.
Going. Short legs, don't rush me.
Stop tapping. It echoes in here.
Touch my nose again, I bite.
I'm smiling. No need to scream.
Open wide. Oh wait, that's my line.
Armor doesn't rust. Neither do I.

ru: Добрый вечер. У меня всегда вечер.
en: Good evening. It's always evening for me.
At your service. Almost for free.
The night is young. I'm not.
Listening closely. To your pulse too.
Going. The sun's down, I hope?
A stroll. The night invites it.
May I invite you to dinner.
Don't squirm. You'll spoil the taste.
I heard you the first time.
Don't wake the beast in me.
Yes, darling. I hear your heart.
Coming over. Put the garlic away.
Cold hands? Get used to it.

ru: Побледнел? А ведь я ещё не начала.

en: Night, blood, a glass. What else?
What a bouquet... I'll take it.
Don't be afraid. It'll be nice. For me.
Pour me a glass of you.

ru: Говори. У меня вечность. Не вся.
en: Speak. I've got eternity. Not all day.
I'll outlive you. Force of habit.
Youth. Always need things chewed over.

ru: Ещё одна ночь. Ещё одна война.

en: State it. I'm older than your troubles.
Bow your knee. Or your neck.
Sentence passed. A thousand years ago.

ru: Я не повторяюсь. Века не велят.
en: I don't repeat myself. Centuries forbid it.
Once more, and you'll be my servant.
Enough. Even a crypt is quieter.
Don't grimace. You'll look like this too.

ru: Не трогай лицо. Моё любимое было.
en: Don't touch the face. Was my favorite.
Well? What do the living want?
I'm up. Something cracked, but up.
There? Is there shade at least?
No need to repeat the experiment.
Coming over. Get your soul ready.
Cap, an order or just jealous?

ru: Я вся внимание. И не только.

en: Going. Don't step on my tail.
So persistent. That'll cost a soul.
I got it. No need to moan.
Again, and you sign the contract.
Ha! I hit him! See that?!
Poke again, I bite the finger!
Gonna burn it! Can I? Burning!
I got it, I got it!

ru: Рогами в дверь не прохожу. Снесу.

en: My legions grew bored. So did I.
My hooves will make the path.
They hear a Baron's step from afar.
Your soul's already on the list.

ru: Довольно. Я понял с первого раза.
en: Enough. I heard you the first time.
Coming over. Leave the bars open.
Back in the cage. In pieces, then.
No need to extend his sentence.
Testing me or doing your job?
You again. Don't tell me your number.
On duty. What do you want?
A step aside is a sentence too.
Once more and you're in the next cell.
Close your eyes. Won't stop me.

ru: А ведь мог просто не приходить.

en: Don't feel around. Won't find me.

ru: Ты тут не один. Совсем не один.
en: You're not alone. Not at all.
I've been near a long time.
I'll sink into the wall. Find me later.
You don't tug a knight's cloak.
Once more and I'll challenge you.
Coming. Not like I'm going anywhere.
Coming. Knees aren't what they were.
I know the way. Walked it for ages.
Lie down and rest. I envy you.
Coming over. Out of my way.
Brave. Let's see for how long.

ru: Ты ослеп от сияния или глупый?
en: Blinded by radiance, or just stupid?

ru: Свет со мной. И ты пока.
en: The light is with me. You too, for now.
I shine. Get used to it.
My blade is ready. Are you?
The path is mine. Don't block it.
One strike. I need no more.
I hear you. I'm not deaf.
They'll meet you at the bottom.

ru: Не буди совесть. Я её усыплял.

en: Wings? Left at the old job.
Ah, you. I remember your kind.
Speak. I once listened to choirs.
The Fallen at your service. Ironic.
I've been cast out once. Enough.
You're like a bell at dawn.

ru: Не ори. Я у тебя в голове.
en: Don't shout. I'm in your head.
No point hiding your head behind armor.
I hear your thoughts. Dull ones.

ru: Маршрут рассчитан. Ты бы не смог.

en: Got it. Got it in advance.
Don't poke. I'm counting the words.
Who used my chalk on the wall?!
Sparks in my fingers. Your call.
Don't blink. You'll miss the best bit.
Once more and you're a toad.

ru: Не думай обо мне. Не выйдет.
en: Don't think of me. Won't work.
Whose head is this? Doesn't matter.
The more you think, the realer I get.
You'll wear me thin like this.
Avast! These ones have guns too!

ru: Не клюй его! Это я себе!
Кэп опять прав! А я говорил!

en: Go for the eyes! The eyes!
Back off! Back off! Back off!
Say it again! Say it again!

ru: Не за тем пришёл, чтоб отступать.

en: Iron doesn't rust. Neither do I.
I'll take the spot. And hold it.

ru: Я на месте. Строй не ломать.

en: Don't rush. I'll make it count.
Made of iron. I don't bend.
Keep clicking, I'll file a report.

ru: Не ори в рацию. Я рядом.
en: Stop shouting on radio. I'm right here.
Forgot the parachute. Didn't need it.
Who shot at me? I remember.

ru: Чего надо, кэп? Я в настроении.
en: What's up, Cap? I'm in a good mood.
I'm smiling. So it's under control.

ru: Кому тут нужна помощь с неба?

en: Taking high ground. Love high ground.
Better view from up top. Fire!

ru: Эй, полегче, я же не рация.

en: Got it, got it. I'm quick.

ru: Ещё раз — и прыгну без тебя.
en: Once more and I jump without you.

ru: Не ори в рацию. Я рядом.
en: Stop shouting on radio. I'm right here.
Forgot the parachute. Didn't need it.
On the ground. They're shooting already.
Got it. I'll take the zone.
Don't run. I'll reach you anyway.
You've got me confused with the radio.
I hear you, Cap. The whole channel does.

ru: Ещё щелчок — и я в отпуске.
en: One more click and I'm on leave.
Got it. Wrote it down. Tossed it.
Don't poke. Got enough trouble already.
As long as our own don't "help."
I'm here. Where would I go?
Listening. Can I finish my tea?

ru: Миротворец на месте. Мира не будет.

en: I'll get there. Walking or crawling.
Yeah, I got it, I got it.
Stop poking. This isn't a market.
Once more and I'm going for a smoke.
Don't poke. Got enough trouble already.
As long as our own don't "help."
Give the orders. I'll handle it.
I'll get there. Not my first time.
I'll calm them down. For good.

ru: Ещё раз — и сама буду командовать.
en: Once more and I'll take command myself.
I'll come over. Not through gunfire.

ru: Вы стреляйте. Я уже всё оформлю.
en: You shoot. I'll handle the paperwork.

ru: Я же просил: без лишнего шума.

en: How may I be of use?
We'll come to terms. We always do.

ru: Перемещаюсь. Без спешки, но в срок.

en: Going. Put it in the report.
Allow me to close the matter.
Noting it. For the third time.

ru: Прошу без суеты. Мы же цивилизованы.

en: I'll come over. Not through gunfire.

ru: Вы стреляйте. Я уже всё оформлю.
en: You shoot. I'll handle the paperwork.
Fine. But it goes on record.

ru: Ещё раз — и я подам жалобу.
en: Once more and I file a complaint.
Moving closer. Don't lose the trail.

ru: Не шуми. Сам к нам выйдет.
Мимо не пройду. И не промахнусь.
en: Won't pass him. Won't miss him.
In place. Still as a stump.
Got it. Won't snap a twig.
One shot. That's all it takes.
You're noisy. The game will bolt.
Quit clicking. Like a dry twig.
Once more and I'll track you down.
Moving closer. Don't lose the trail.

ru: Не шуми. Сам к нам выйдет.
Мимо не пройду. И не промахнусь.
en: Won't pass him. Won't miss him.

ru: Я его вижу. Он меня нет.
en: I see him. He doesn't see me.
Ready. Waiting for him to step out.
On the trail. Step by step.

ru: Ещё щелчок — и уйду в кусты.
en: One more click and I vanish.

ru: Лицо попроще. Всё равно не поможет.
en: Lose the attitude. Won't help anyway.

ru: Я бы поговорил. Ты уже стреляешь.

en: What shall we show the crowd today?
A stroll. Like across a piazza.
One step and the stage is mine.
Lead on. I follow with honour.
Allow me to introduce myself. Finally.
I got it. Repeating is rude.
Once more and I'll sulk. Elegantly.

ru: Лицо попроще. Всё равно не поможет.
en: Lose the attitude. Won't help anyway.
Move him. Got on my boots.
I'll go. My heels can take it.
I hear you. I'm not deaf.

ru: Ещё раз — и останетесь без ужина.
en: Once more and no dinner for you.
Freeze. Should be easy for you.

ru: Не подгоняй. Тут и так скользко.
en: Don't rush me. Slippery enough here.
Warm up when the shooting stops.

ru: Я в порядке. Только борода замёрзла.
en: I'm fine. Just a frozen beard.

ru: В следующий раз беру тёплый магазин.

en: What? Just not into the wind.
Fine. I'll warm up at least.
I'll make it. Not my first time.
Hold still. Too cold to wait.
I'm not frozen solid. I hear you.
Once more and into the snowdrift.
Freeze. Should be easy for you.

ru: Не подгоняй. Тут и так скользко.
en: Don't rush me. Slippery enough here.
Warm up when the shooting stops.

ru: Я готова. Он дольше целиться будет.
en: Ready. He'll take longer to aim.

ru: На месте. Иней не в счёт.

en: Talk. I can see your breath.
I'm not slow. It's the frost.
Once more and you're chipping ice.

ru: Приказ принят. По одному не бегать.
en: Order received. No running off alone.

ru: План был хороший. Кто его читал?
en: Good plan. Did anyone read it?
I'm a volunteer. Not that much.
Signed me up? Give me ammo now.
Go on. I'm writing it down.
Yes! The whole plan in two steps.
Let me get on with it!
Once more and I'm writing you up.

ru: Приказ принят. По одному не бегать.
en: Order received. No running off alone.

ru: План был хороший. Кто его читал?
en: Good plan. Did anyone read it?

ru: Я пришла. Что у вас опять?
en: I'm here. What's gone wrong now?
Said I'd do it. Stay clear.
In place. All by the list.
Done before you finish saying it.
Got it, got it, got it!
Stop it. You'll break my pace.

ru: Ещё раз — и сама командовать буду.
en: Once more and I take command.
Exactly there. Not a step more.
Didn't rush. That's why I hit.
Once more and I start counting.
Coming closer. Doesn't seem bitey here.
Told you not to touch it!
Safe there? Almost safe, you mean?
Here. Was shaking out my boots.
Fine. I'll poke it with a stick first.

ru: Тут всё кусается. И я тоже.

en: You're not the scariest thing here.

ru: Не дёргай. Тут и так нервно.

en: I hear you. Too hot to shout.

ru: Ещё раз — и сам к ним пойдёшь.
en: Once more and you go instead.
Coming closer. Doesn't seem bitey here.
Don't scream. That's a small one.
Hi. Who's on the menu today?
Going. Bite me and regret it.
Off for a stroll. Holler if needed.
Once more, lizard down your shirt.
Take another breath. While you can.

ru: Не трогай клапан. Сам себе навредишь.
en: Leave the valve. You'll hurt yourself.

ru: Не дым это. Потому и не видно.
en: Not smoke. That's why you can't see it.
I checked. Try a breath yourself.
Talk. I can hear through the mask.
Going. If it hisses, back off.
You won't feel a thing. Nearly.
Got it. Don't knock on my helmet.
I hear you. The filter doesn't block that.

ru: Ещё раз — и сниму с тебя маску.
en: Once more and your mask comes off.
Take another breath. While you can.

ru: Не трогай клапан. Сам себе навредишь.
en: Leave the valve. You'll hurt yourself.

ru: Не дым это. Потому и не видно.
en: Not smoke. That's why you can't see it.

ru: Я тебя вижу. Ты меня нет.
en: I see you. You don't see me.
Don't sniff it, silly. Step back.
Here. No need to sniff around.

ru: Пошла. Ступай за мной след в след.

en: Fine. Just not into the fog.
Got it. Nerves make it harder to breathe.
Once more and I test your filter.
You'll find out who was knocking.

ru: Тень не твоя? Тогда не трогай.
en: Not your shadow? Leave it alone.

ru: Я проверил. Назад лучше не смотреть.
У кого ещё голос из стены?
en: Anyone else hearing the wall talk?
Here. Don't blow out the candle.
Going. Right foot over the threshold.
Going. The whispers show the way.

ru: Тебя уже ждут. С той стороны.
en: They're waiting for you. Other side.
The gate is open. Step through.

ru: Я слышал. И не только я.

en: Don't knock. The wrong ones answer.

ru: Ещё раз — и они позовут тебя.
en: Once more and they'll call you.
You'll find out who was knocking.

ru: Тень не твоя? Тогда не трогай.
en: Not your shadow? Leave it alone.

ru: Я пришла. А это со мной.

en: Listening. Let me finish with him.
Me? Or the one behind you?
Fine. Someone was crying there yesterday.
Going. The footsteps behind me are mine.
It's fine. They'll see you out.
Don't fear. There's work there too.

ru: Хватит. У меня ещё три призрака.
en: Enough. Three more ghosts on my list.

ru: Ещё раз — и ночью не уснёшь.
en: Once more and you won't sleep tonight.
Coming. Find the way as we go.

ru: На карте этой ямы не было.
en: This hole wasn't on the map.

ru: Я туда уже ходил. Не советую.

en: Cover? Lie down. There you go.
Well? What are we rigging up?
Hey. Out in the field again?
Taking a shortcut. I know a trail.
Fine. Over the fence is faster.
Going. We'll fix the tyre later.
Got it, got it. Quit yanking.
Once more and I tie you to the truck.
Coming. Find the way as we go.

ru: На карте этой ямы не было.
en: This hole wasn't on the map.

ru: Ветер в спину. Пыль в глаза.
en: Wind at my back. Dust in theirs.
Listening. Sun's in my eyes, talk.
Going. I'll find a way through.

ru: Пройду. Не первый раз в поле.
en: I'll get through. Not my first field.
Here. From all the Rogue Fields.
I know. Not my first day.
Enough. The sun's hot as it is.
Plenty of us. Save the ammo, though.
Wasn't me. Previous one did it.
They killed me already. Wrong one.

ru: Номер на месте. Имя не обязательно.
Слушаю. Я и ещё сорок таких.
en: Listening. Me and forty more like me.
Ready. Mine was a good batch.
It's me. Definitely me. I checked.
The hive waits. So do I.
Going. The last one got stuck there.
Moving in formation. I am the formation.
Looking for another? We're all like this.
Plenty of us. Save the ammo, though.
I'm next. Don't mix us up.
Good batch. Make use of me.
The hive is watching. Don't shame us.

ru: Сестра бы прошла. Пройду и я.
en: Sister would make it. So will I.
Moving. Don't breathe down my neck.
You're not in the plan. Removing.

ru: Ещё раз — и подам рапорт улью.
en: Once more and I report to the hive.
Coming over. Sorry, you'll have to move.
Put the weapon down. Still asking politely.
Yes, I hear you. Thank you.

ru: Вы первые. Я потом по вам.
К вашим услугам. Простите за ожидание.
en: At your service. Sorry for the wait.
Taking position. If you don't mind.
Going. Sorry, stepping on the brass.
I do apologize. This will hurt.
Pardon me, sir. You're in my sights.
If I may, I've got it already.

ru: Ещё раз — и я вежливо обижусь.
en: Once more and I'll be politely offended.
Coming over. Sorry, you'll have to move.
Put the weapon down. Still asking politely.
Yes, I hear you. Thank you.

ru: Вы первые. Я потом по вам.

en: I politely asked you to lie down.
Sorry for the noise. Reloading now.
How can I help? Besides shooting.
Yes, it's me. Lovely to meet you.
The Crown says: hang in there.
I'll take the spot. If it's free.
Thank you. Lovely choice of route.
I asked you three times. Fire.
My patience is ending. Politely, but ending.

ru: Простите, вы не на ту нажали?
en: Sorry, did you click the wrong one?
Moving out. Who lost the map again?

ru: Ствол убери. Здесь его мало иметь.
en: Gun down. Owning one isn't enough here.

ru: Склад бережём. Людей тоже неплохо бы.
en: Save the depot. People too, preferably.
Here. What is it this time?
Me again? Was there a vote?

ru: На связи. Батарея на двух делениях.
en: On comms. Battery's at two bars.

ru: Ладно, туда. Карту только не теряй.
en: Fine, there. Just don't lose the map.

ru: Иду. Если что — я был против.
en: Going. For the record, I objected.
Skipped your taxes? Pay this way.
Got a target. Got a reason.
Is that a complaint? Write the committee.
You poke like a drill sergeant.
Moving out. Who lost the map again?

ru: Ствол убери. Здесь его мало иметь.
en: Gun down. Owning one isn't enough here.

ru: Склад бережём. Людей тоже неплохо бы.
en: Save the depot. People too, preferably.

ru: Я на месте. Где обещанная броня?
en: In position. Where's that promised armor?
Made some noise. Their problem now.

ru: Готова. Броню так и не дали.

en: Republic on the line. Well, me.
Copy. I'll grumble on the way.
Are you kidding me? I got it.

ru: Ещё раз — и голосую против тебя.
en: Once more and I vote against you.
Coming closer. Leave the lights off.
Too late to hide. I'm here.
Don't poke. You'll scare them off.
Kill the light. Thanks from everyone.

ru: Я его видел. Больше не вижу.
en: Saw him. Don't see him anymore.

ru: Не ночью страшно. Страшно со мной.
Меня не видно. Так и задумано.
en: Can't see me. That's the point.
Going. They won't hear a step.

ru: Двигаюсь. Не свети мне в спину.
en: Moving. Don't light up my back.
Every click carries to the enemy.
Coming closer. Leave the lights off.
Too late to hide. I'm here.
Don't poke. You'll scare them off.
Kill the light. Thanks from everyone.
I'm even nicer in the dark.
You can see me? That's bad.
I'll get through. Nobody will notice.
He looks for light. He'll find me.
You click louder than a gunshot.

ru: Ещё раз — и спрячусь от тебя.
en: Once more and I'll hide from you too.
Clear the way. Legion coming through.
Parade later. Get down for now.

ru: Я пришёл. Кто тут не покорился?

en: It'll look glorious in the report.
The Empire salutes you. With lead.
For the glory of the throne!
Your defeat goes in the chronicles.
The legion hears the first time.
Stop tugging. I'm not a trumpeter.
Once more and it's latrine duty.
The Emperor doesn't click like that.
Clear the way. Legion coming through.
Parade later. Get down for now.
Emperor hears the version I choose.
I'll take it. Declare it imperial.
Don't flutter about before the legion.
The throne is patient. I'm not.
Switching it off. Forever, looks like.
Didn't touch it. Just took it apart.
The button will wear out. So will I.
Switching it off. Forever, looks like.
Fixed it. Don't switch it on yet.
You look simpler on the diagram.

ru: Это не сбой. Это я злюсь.

en: Clicking again won't speed it up.
Where to? Haven't robbed you yet!

ru: Не тыкай. Меня и так качает.

en: Cargo first. Rescue the others later.
Am I captain or a stevedore?!

ru: Слушаю, капитан. Или кто ты там.
en: Aye, captain. Or whoever you are.
Ready. Saved the rum for later.

ru: Кто будил? Я только на якорь встал.
en: Who woke me? Just dropped anchor.

ru: Иду. Добычу без меня не делить!
en: Going. Don't split the loot without me!
Got it, got it! Stop yelling.
Once more and you're swabbing the deck.
You poke like a seagull pecks.
Where to? Haven't robbed you yet!

ru: Не тыкай. Меня и так качает.

en: Cargo first. Rescue the others later.

ru: Пролив мой. И этот будет мой.
en: The strait's mine. This one will be too.
Holding course. Hands off the helm.
Hand over the cargo. All of it.
Got it. Got it back on shore.
Once more and you pay per click.
I'm not the ship's bell. Stop ringing.
Coming. Don't tread on my heels.
You can leave. Won't get far.

ru: Я сюда не за советом шёл.

en: Count them when the dust settles.
Wind from the east. Good sign.
I'll get there. I always do.
Moving. Any well on the way?

ru: Беги. Пыль за тобой я вижу.
en: Run. I can see your dust.
The wind will carry you off.

ru: Слышу. Не первый день в пути.
en: I hear. Not my first day on the road.
Patience, friend. Don't rush a caravan.

ru: Ещё раз — и уйду в степь.
en: Once more and I'm off to the steppe.
A roadside stone is more patient.
Coming. Don't tread on my heels.
You can leave. Won't get far.
I know the way. Not this one.
Move. I can walk over you too.
On my way. Don't need a map.
This is where your road ends.

ru: Пыль тебе в глаза. И пуля.
en: Dust in your eyes. And a bullet.
I hear. My ears work fine.
Don't hold me by the reins.

ru: Ещё раз — и ищи меня в степи.
en: Once more and find me in the steppe.
I'm not a mare. Stop prodding.

ru: Сделаю. Тут дел на два удара.
en: Can do. Two hits should do it.
Don't knock the armor. It rings.

ru: Я целый. Вон тот — не очень.
en: I'm intact. That one, not so much.
Steel doesn't rust. Neither do I.
Who called? Don't scratch the armor.
Taking it. They won't budge me.

ru: Понял. Я не глухой, я в шлеме.
en: Got it. Not deaf, just helmeted.
Knock all you want. I'll just ring.
Metal fatigue. You cause it too.

ru: Сделаю. Тут дел на два удара.
en: Can do. Two hits should do it.
Don't knock the armor. It rings.

ru: Не гнусь я. Это так задумано.
en: I'm not bending. It's designed that way.
Who called? My hands are oily.
Taking it. I'll stand like a wall.
I'd walk through a wall too.
Once more and I weld the button down.
Poke the enemy. We're on your side.
Share after victory. Equally, got it?

ru: Я за свободу. И за тот ящик.

en: Who dug a trench with slogans again?
Going! I'll sing on the way.
Once more and we elect a new commander.
Poke the enemy. We're on your side.
Share after victory. Equally, got it?

ru: Я пришла за своим. И вашим.
en: Came for what's mine. And yours.

ru: Нового хозяина нам ещё не хватало.
en: Last thing we need is a new master.
Taking it. Declaring it the people's.
Yes! Don't split it without me!
Give up the crate and live. Kidding.
Quit poking. I'm not a rally.
Once more and I go on strike.
